text:
priyanka: quick sync on visibility roadmap. PMs pushed ACME + beta org asks: per-model cost breakdown, route-level error analytics, and tracing hooks. need scope decision for next launch.

dave: can we trim to cost + errors only and push tracing hooks to phase 2? :thinking:

elaine: ACME flagged per-model cost as procurement must-have. they also want per-route error histograms. tracing hooks can be minimal: span-tagging + sampling config.

samir: tracing hooks are heavier than they sound. minimal approach: span-id passthrough + sampling (1% default) and per-org overrides. full trace ingest = phase 2.

carla: acceptance criteria ask: "cost per 1k tokens by model + route" + 30d retention. confirm?

priyanka: proposal: MVP = dashboards (3 widgets: latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, error rate by route), tracing hooks = span tagging + sampling config (no raw trace retention), cost API = per-model breakdown, 30d retention; rollout = canary to 5% orgs, include ACME opt-in day1.

dave: +1 but add perf budget: dashboard queries must return <1s for 95% of calls. that gate can't be relaxed.

elaine: for error analytics we need top-10 error signatures, sample examples, and model/version filters. that will satisfy support triage needs.

samir: infra note: sampling @1% yields ~estimates I'll add to the doc. we also need a BFF endpoint for cost aggregation. timeline?

priyanka: timeline idea: scoped PR end of sprint (2 weeks), internal canary week after, GA in 6 weeks if no regressions.

carla: risk: naive cost computation will be expensive. suggest pre-aggregation via per-request tags + nightly rollups to keep dashboards snappy.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary window: 1755880000 -> 1755883600

dave: action items: Samir = owner tracing hooks; Carla = owner cost aggregation; Elaine = owner dashboard UX; Priyanka = rollout + PM comms. i'll create cards.

priyanka: please confirm owners. any absolute "must keep" items? @ACME would you accept no raw trace retention in MVP (sampling-only)?

elaine: i'll ping ACME and thread back.

samir: ok from infra. adding sampling config snippet to the design doc:

```
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01
  per_org_overrides: true
span_tags:
  include: [model.id, route, user_id_hash]
```

priyanka: sounds good. closing here: ship trimmed visibility MVP with canary + ACME opt-in. follow-up doc to scope phase 2 full-trace ingest and long-term retention.
